other.tags: Lo-fi hip hop. A vinyl crackle texture persists throughout the track. The drum pattern consists of a muffled, low-pass filtered kick drum and a crisp, dry snare on the backbeat. A Rhodes electric piano plays a repeating four-bar progression of jazz-influenced seventh chords with a slight tremolo effect. A melodic flute line enters with heavy reverb and delay, performing short, pentatonic phrases. The bass is a sub-heavy sine wave that follows the root notes of the electric piano. 85 BPM. 4/4 time signature. Key of C minor.

bass.tags: Industrial hip hop. A distorted, overdriven kick drum plays a syncopated pattern with a heavy emphasis on the downbeat. A recurring, dissonant two-note synth motif with a gritty, saw-tooth texture repeats every two bars. The tempo is 90 BPM in 4/4 time. The mix is characterized by heavy saturation and a narrow stereo field. A rhythmic, mechanical clicking sound occurs on every sixteenth note.
